description: This file defines various data structures (structs) used for communication between components or services in a bridging context, including request, response, event, and error frames, along with helper message types such as hello, pair, ping/pong, and RPC messages. These structures enable encoding and decoding of messages exchanged via JSON in a systematic way.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializers for each data structure, used to create instances with optional default parameters.
